key_insight: ElasticTTT fixes a mismatch in test-time tuning by preserving the diffusion model’s prior distribution, preventing collapse to the source video and improving one-shot video editing.
engineering_relevance: For practical video editing systems, the method offers a way to adapt pretrained diffusion models at inference time without sacrificing diversity, text control, or spatial separation.
method: Target Distribution Regularization avoids sharp memorization minima during tuning.
Contrastive CFG steers generation away from source-video bias.
Asynchronous Noise Schedule protects unedited regions from unintended changes.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive evaluations and theoretical analysis, with state-of-the-art performance on one-shot video editing.
watch_item: The added tuning and scheduling components may increase implementation complexity and require careful hyperparameter calibration to avoid unstable inference.
paper_title: ElasticTTT: Prior-Preserving Test-Time Tuning for Video Editing
